sources.name: UBC Okanagan Events Calendar
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] with title/description/venue/cost. Campus-wide (talks, workshops, student life), not international-student-specific, but Global Engagement Office and Student Services post orientation/newcomer programming here. DISABLED 2026-08-26: this feed crashes the shared parse_tribe() in build_board.py (line ~160) with AttributeError - some events (e.g. thesis defenses with multiple venue options, and events with no venue) return e['venue'] as a LIST of venue dicts instead of a single dict, and v.get('venue') then fails since v is a list not a dict. This is a build_board.py bug, not a config issue - not fixed here per the no-shared-file-edits rule for this task; re-enable once parse_tribe handles list-typed venue (e.g. take v[0] or join multiple venues) centrally. Confirmed via: python -c exercising parse_tribe on this source raised 'AttributeError: list object has no attribute get' at the exact v.get('venue') call.

sources.name: Okanagan College - International Education
sources.notes: Best-fit source (International Education Week, International Orientation for 550+ students/term). The public /events page is a Drupal 9/10 JSON:API-backed Angular app ('oc_events' module) - confirmed 2026-08-26 by reading its own network calls: the real events feed is Drupal JSON:API at /jsonapi/node/events (filtered by field_event_date_range.value BETWEEN two dates), verified reachable directly with curl and returning real dated events (e.g. 'Fall Convocation 2026 (Kelowna)'). Not tribe/sqs/communico/ical - needs a small Drupal-JSON:API parser (read data[].attributes.title / body / field_event_date_range, and data[].relationships.field_event_campus) added centrally; the URL field above is the exact working request. International Education Week hand-entered in manual_events below in the meantime.

sources.name: Okanagan Regional Library
sources.notes: Runs on BiblioCommons (confirmed via page source 2026-08-26), not Communico/libnet like Hamilton/Kingston libraries - no existing parser handles this platform. Multiple Kelowna branches (Downtown, Mission, Rutland, Ellison) with programs pages; worth a BiblioCommons parser centrally if this platform recurs across other cities.

sources.name: KCR Community Resources - Immigrant & Settlement Services
sources.notes: Central Okanagan's main immigrant/settlement services agency - Volunteer Friendship for Newcomers, Community Connections, pre-employment and tax/tenancy workshops. WordPress site but wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not The Events Calendar plugin. Instead runs the Event Espresso plugin (confirmed via page network requests loading 'event-espresso-core-reg' assets) - build_board.py already has a parse_event_espresso parser for exactly this platform, and this site's REST namespace is confirmed live at https://kcr.ca/wp-json/ee/v4.8.36 (also v4.8.29/33/34 present). Deliberately left as kind probe rather than switched to event_espresso per this task's scope restriction to tribe/sqs/communico/ical/manual/probe only - flip the kind and set url to that namespace base to activate; should work with no further discovery needed.

sources.name: WorkBC Employment Services Centre - Kelowna
sources.notes: Provincial employment services centre with newcomer/immigrant-specific programming (Career Paths for Skilled Immigrants, YESS). WordPress site, no /events route found (404) 2026-08-26 - workshops likely announced via in-centre postings or a newsletter, not a public calendar.

sources.name: City of Kelowna Events Calendar
sources.notes: Drupal 7 site; the /rest/events path returns server-rendered HTML, not JSON, regardless of Accept header (confirmed 2026-08-26). An RSS feed exists at kelowna.ca/rss/events.xml (valid RSS 2.0) but no existing parser kind handles bare RSS - candidate for a small generic-RSS parser if this recurs. City also runs the 'Newcomers' resource hub page linked as home.

sources.name: Downtown Kelowna Association
sources.notes: WordPress site, wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not The Events Calendar plugin, custom events template instead. Runs the Thursday Night Market (May-Sept, ends Sept 3 2026) and Meet Me on Bernard programming - good social fit once a feed or reliable scrape point is found.

sources.name: Tourism Kelowna Events
sources.notes: wp-json/tribe/events route 301-redirects rather than returning JSON 2026-08-26 (openresty edge in front); aggregates festivals across the whole Central Okanagan including Center of Gravity and other major festivals. Worth re-probing the redirect target directly.

sources.name: Evangel Church Kelowna - ESL Ministry
sources.notes: Standing weekly ESL classes (High Beginner 9-11am, Intermediate 11:30am-1:30pm) explicitly for international/newcomer adults - contact esl@evangelkelowna.com. No dated feed, term-based standing program only. Left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Okanagan College - International Education (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Manual-kind twin of the okanagan-college probe source above, needed because build_board.py's parse_manual() only fires for sources whose own kind is 'manual' - a manual_events entry pointing at a probe-kind source_id is silently dropped (confirmed by testing; this also appears to affect the existing Kingston config's QUIC-sourced manual event, worth checking there too). Holds the one hand-verified dated item until the real Drupal JSON:API parser exists.

sources.name: Kelowna Gospel Fellowship
sources.notes: Runs on Planning Center's Church Center app, not a scrapable calendar platform we support. Included as a spiritual-stream candidate for hand-entry when a specific newcomer/international event is announced - no dated events confirmed yet 2026-08-26.
